notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.624.04
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"][/img]     Patch 0.31.624.04[/h1][p][/p][h3]BUG - auto update not updating to two levels on a component if the first is not researched[/h3][p][/p][h3]setup more game resolutions, restrict invalid ones for display being used[/h3][p]There are now 324 potential resolution combinations, but to simplify and avoid screen errors, I have the current display scanned for its max width and height to only offer resolutions on those boundaries.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/23f5c4adcf96b765cd767fb76067376a6dd9d23d.png"][/img][/p][h3]move local options out of game options[/h3][p]This is in preparation for my deeper dive into figuring out cloud saves with Steam. My first attempt was a fail, but hopefully by separating screen size and sounds from game options this will work better for people playing APW on a PC and on a Steamdeck.[/p][p][/p][h3]change market orders, remove 5 orders and add 10000 instead[/h3][p]During testing I'm noticing that large orders are common, this allows for 10000 units at a time to be transacted with one button push.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/f9c728d22b15bf5f3547174b8f047d2e361e7bed.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.31.62401
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"][/img]   Version 0.3162401[/h1][p][/p][h3]Disable steam cloud saves for now[/h3][p]The Cloud Save system is sort of working, but more work has to be done to make this work properly, so I am disabling it for now.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fix full-screen so it properly resets after setting[/h3][p]This issue was around for a while, when a user changes the full-screen option it doesn't show up until the player logs into a game. Now it changes as soon as the option is saved as it should be.[/p][p][/p][h3]Remove campaign game from game for now[/h3][p]Some early feedback from some of our new testers gave me some good feedback not to show a feature like the campaign until it's more properly explained and fleshed out. The campaign is functioning, but it needs some work, so I will remove it for now and continue to work on it before releasing it back to testers. The skirmish and multiplayer modes are functioning quite well and are consistent to each other.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer creation grabs from APW100+ single player from APW1+ and provides game name in email[/h3][p]This was another good catch from our new testers, they tried to start a multiplayer game on the official APW server, but the default game number was already in use. This made me realize that a better method would be to ask the game server for the next available number from APW100 onwards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Add in a feature to auto-upgrade a ship[/h3][p]This was requested by a tester and makes sense, a user now can click an auto-update button on the design screen. This button will only be enabled if the ship design is behind in technology from the latest researched components and weapons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/b519d39f9ba662700ec340b97603c4f4eee068ec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Pets level up quicker earlier[/h3][p]I noticed that it's taking too long for pets to level up, which is half the fun of having pets in APW. I have reduced the experience required to level pets in the early levels.[/p]

notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.61602
notes.notes: [h1]Patch 0.31.61602[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"][/img][/p][h3]change fullscreen to windowed fullscreen[/h3][p]fullscreen has now been modified to windowless, which works better based on initial testing.[/p][p][/p][h3]show fleets that don't have all ships assigned for tactics if tactics are available[/h3][p]fleet icons now will pulse if there are ships that need to be placed in the tactics screen to remind the player.[/p][p][/p][h3]make adding ships to ship tactics auto select left-most ship[/h3][p]fleet tactics are a little faster to implement.[/p][p][/p]
